  4. Round 48the lobe storm dies; the residual turns out to be a physics limitscored

    ■fail

    2026-08-16 01:29 UTC

    An anchor-relative amplitude floor kills M26's lone-knock ring storm at every decay from 25 to 80 ms, and keeps the held-out pass exactly (desk 20/20, soft 20/20, lap 20/20, 0 FP, p95 203.9 ms). Real rescues sit at 0.382-1.328 of their anchor; the two storm families at 0.031-0.131 and 0.175-0.235. The empty band is 0.235 to 0.382.

    biggest gapM26 asks the input gate to catch 2.4x as much: un-gated typing triggers go 63->137 desk, 35->80 soft, 12->45 lap, and the anchor floor removes almost none. Read against the right baseline though, the shipped detector is ALREADY 188x over the bar un-gated and M26 is 449x - neither is usable without the gate, which the PRD makes load-bearing by design. Gated, every config reads 0. The real blocker is unchanged: zero lap confound recordings, so lap's false-trigger bar has no denominator.
